description: This file exports a runtime interface for Google Chat channels by re-exporting functions imported from other modules, specifically 'api.js' and 'monitor.js'. It consolidates key functions like probing, messaging, uploading attachments, resolving webhook paths, and starting monitors related to Google Chat.

methods.name: probeGoogleChat
methods.description: Function to probe Google Chat for availability or capabilities, mapped to the imported 'probeGoogleChat' implementation.

methods.name: sendGoogleChatMessage
methods.description: Function to send a message to Google Chat, mapped to the imported 'sendGoogleChatMessage' implementation.

methods.name: uploadGoogleChatAttachment
methods.description: Function to upload attachments to Google Chat, mapped to the imported 'uploadGoogleChatAttachment' implementation.

methods.name: resolveGoogleChatWebhookPath
methods.description: Function to resolve webhook URLs for Google Chat, mapped to the imported 'resolveGoogleChatWebhookPath' implementation.

methods.name: startGoogleChatMonitor
methods.description: Function to start monitoring Google Chat channels, mapped to the imported 'startGoogleChatMonitor' implementation.
